learning_outcomes.text: Culminates, in a real professional environment, the acquisition of the competencies that characterize the degree. Integrates the knowledge and skills typical of a Mechanical Engineer with direct experience in a real professional environment. Becomes familiar with the technical means most frequently used by professionals in the field.
Interprets norms, procedures, protocols, standards, manuals and applies them in practical cases.
Drafts documents with the appropriate format, content, structure, linguistic correctness, register, and illustrates concepts correctly using conventions: formats, titles, footers, legends,...
Responds effectively to changes experienced during the course of studies.
Develops strategies to obtain results in due time and with precise scope.
Defines the tasks that allow achieving project objectives.
Foresees and assigns necessary times to complete planned actions.
Actively collaborates in team work planning, in the distribution of roles among its members, and in its orientation towards high performance.
Actively participates in the distribution of responsibilities and tasks according to the potential of each team member.
Values and prioritizes needs and resources in a real project execution situation.
Develops strategies to involve the team in achieving objectives.
Understands the role and expectation that society has of an engineer and the expectation that engineering should have of society.
Contributes to the establishment and application of team work processes.
Actively participates and shares information, knowledge, and experiences.
Develops strategies and methods to constructively solve interpersonal conflicts.
Develops own strategies to solve problems and find solutions.

Analyzes the work or professional environment of the field of study (environment). Designs academic and professional insertion itineraries (itineraries). Identifies one's own learning process (learning). Deepens academic, work, or professional self-knowledge (self-knowledge).
In each case, knows how to formulate the appropriate questions to resolve doubts or open issues and has judgment in information seeking.
Transfers learning from classroom cases and exercises to real situations in other fields.
Analyzes one's limitations and possibilities to perform one's task.
Shows correct judgment to make accurate decisions based on available objective data and information, in an environment of relative uncertainty.
Presents different alternative solution options for the same problem and evaluates their possible risks and advantages.

Recognizes ethical and deontological concepts of the area of knowledge, shows critical capacity and dialogue, and makes responsible use of the norms that affect them as a member of the university community. (Ethics)

Identifies the main environmental problems. (Environment) Recognizes and reflects on social needs and problems and is involved in the improvement of the community. (Social responsibility as a citizen)

teaching_methods: Selection and assignment of external internship placement
Coordination and monitoring mechanisms for external internships

assessment_methods.method: Internship stay evaluation by company tutor
Internship report evaluation by university tutor

assessment_rules: The external evaluation is conducted by the company tutor and accounts for 40% of the grade. The evaluation of the internship by the university tutor accounts for 60% and is based on the student's report at the end of the stay and observations made during the visit to the internship site. The assessment will consider the transversal and core competencies specified in the competencies section.
